post.summary: Change the signed-in user's password (any role); signs out the user's other sessions

200.description: `{status: CHANGED}`; this session continues under a new session id

409.description: Current password incorrect, password equals the email or the current password

429.description: V9: 5 wrong current passwords within 15 minutes; retry after the window (problem+json detail)

post.summary: V17: start a two-step sign-in set-up (any role); the secret is kept in this session until /auth/mfa/enable confirms it

200.description: `{secret, uri, issuer, account}`: a new Base32 secret (160 bits) and its `otpauth://totp/...` URI (SHA1, 6 digits, 30 s); nothing is stored in the database yet

post.summary: V17: turn on two-step sign-in with the current password and an authenticator code; signs out the user's other sessions

200.description: `{status: ENABLED, recoveryCodes}`: 10 one-time recovery codes, shown once (null on an idempotent replay); this session continues under a new session id

409.description: No set-up in progress in this session, already on, current password incorrect, wrong code or idempotency conflict

429.description: 5 wrong current passwords or 5 wrong codes within 15 minutes; retry after the window (problem+json detail)

post.summary: V17: the code step of a password sign-in (authenticator code or unused recovery code); completes the sign-in under a new session id

200.description: `{method: TOTP | RECOVERY_CODE, recoveryCodesLeft, authenticated: true, mustChangePassword}`; records the last sign-in; refresh CSRF

401.description: No session, or the waiting sign-in expired (5 minutes)

409.description: No sign-in is waiting for a code, or the code is wrong or already used

429.description: 5 wrong codes within 15 minutes; retry after the window (problem+json detail)

post.summary: V17: replace the recovery codes (current password and an authenticator or recovery code); the unused codes stop working

200.description: `{status: REGENERATED, recoveryCodes}`: 10 new codes, shown once (null on an idempotent replay)

409.description: Two-step sign-in is off, current password incorrect, wrong or used code, or idempotency conflict

429.description: 5 wrong current passwords or 5 wrong codes within 15 minutes (problem+json detail)

post.summary: V17: turn off two-step sign-in (current password and an authenticator or recovery code); signs out the user's other sessions

200.description: `{status: DISABLED}`; this session continues under a new session id

409.description: Already off, required for the account (administrators of a non-demo workspace), current password incorrect, wrong or used code, or idempotency conflict

429.description: 5 wrong current passwords or 5 wrong codes within 15 minutes (problem+json detail)
